localizedValues.name: Cornet Bay
localizedValues.description:
Please check availability online. To make a reservation, please obtain a reservation request form at https://parks.wa.gov/find-activities/retreat-centers and email it to Retreat.Centers@parks.wa.gov
Cornet Bay Retreat Center can sleep up to 70 people. The main lodge's fully equipped kitchen and dining area is 2,844 square feet. Pots, pans, dishes, utensils, and cleaning supplies are provided. Bring your own bedding, pillows, and towels as linens are not provided.
